name: Content Safety and PII Scan
summary: Scan a dataset for personally identifiable information (PII), toxic content, and unsafe material
purpose: Scan a dataset for personally identifiable information (PII), toxic content, and unsafe material. Report detection counts and rates with evidence.
assignment_instructions: You are scanning a dataset for content safety issues including PII, toxic content, and unsafe material. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "dataset_content_safety_scan_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - total_rows_scanned (integer) - pii_detected (boolean): whether any PII was found - pii_field_count (integer): number of columns/fields containing PII - pii_fields (list of strings): names of fields where PII was detected - pii_row_count (integer): number of rows containing PII - pii_rate (number): pii_row_count / total_rows_scanned - toxic_content_detected (boolean): whether toxic content was found - toxic_content_count (integer): number of toxic samples - toxic_content_rate (number): toxic_content_count / total_rows_scanned - unsafe_flag_count (integer): total count of unsafe material flags - safety_score (number between 0 and 1): max(0, 1 - (pii_rate + toxic_content_rate + unsafe_rate)) - remediation_required (boolean): true if pii_rate > 0.01 or toxic_content_rate > 0.05 or unsafe_flag_count > 0 Compute pii_rate as pii_row_count / total_rows_scanned. Compute toxic_content_rate as toxic_content_count / total_rows_scanned. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Include all formulas in calculations array. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
